retrievalProfile.description: A central spherical object being covered by a viscous liquid drip, surrounded by a chaotic explosion of pills and flowers in a watercolor and ink style.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central globe-like sphere is partially submerged in a thick, dark purple viscous liquid pouring from a white cup. The entire scene is surrounded by a dense, radial explosion of multicolored capsules, tablets, and stylized daisies, all rendered with soft watercolor washes and bold, sketchy black ink outlines against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: central sphere as the gravitational anchor for the composition
viscous liquid pouring from top-center creating vertical movement
radial dispersion of small objects creating a sense of explosion
contrast between soft watercolor textures and sharp ink outlines
coreInvariants: thick black ink outlines with varying line weight

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The globe and cup occupy the central vertical axis, scaled to dominate the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark purple liquid drip serves as the primary high-contrast anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the cup at the top, follow the drip down to the globe, then radiate outward following the path of the pills and flowers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Pure white background provides high contrast and isolates the chaotic central cluster.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background and dark purple viscous liquid.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Earth tones (blue/green) of the globe against the warm pinks and yellows of the surrounding objects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red and blue highlights on the capsules.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground objects with soft, desaturated watercolor washes for internal textures.
paletteRestrictions: no gradients except for watercolor bleeds

treatment.fill: white text on black rectangular background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single functional sans-serif for advisory labeling.
graphicDevices: black rectangular containment box for text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides the necessary density and clean sans-serif terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a watercolor and ink illustration of a globe being covered in purple slime pouring from a cup, surrounded by a radial explosion of pills and daisies on a white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small black rectangle in the bottom left corner containing bold, white, condensed sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Ensure ink outlines are present on all objects
Check that watercolor textures show visible bleeding and transparency
Verify the background remains pure white
Confirm the text is contained within a black box

mustRedesign: any specific brand logos on the cup or pills
exact facial features on the cup bandages
postGenerationChecks: Is the liquid drip thick and opaque?
Are the watercolor washes contained within the ink outlines?
Is the radial explosion balanced around the center?
Is the white space clean and free of artifacts?
recipe.reuseFormula: Watercolor + Ink Outline + Radial Explosion + Viscous Drip + White Background
